scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const srcJs = 'node_modules/opencascade.js/dist/opencascade.wasm.js'; const srcWasm = 'node_modules/opencascade.js/dist/opencascade.wasm.wasm'; if (fs.existsSync(srcJs)) { fs.mkdirSync('public/occ', { recursive: true }); fs.copyFileSync(srcJs, 'public/occ/opencascade.wasm.js'); if (fs.existsSync(srcWasm)) fs.copyFileSync(srcWasm, 'public/occ/opencascade.wasm.wasm'); let content = fs.readFileSync('public/occ/opencascade.wasm.js', 'utf8'); content = content.replace('export default opencascade;', 'self.initOpenCascade = opencascade;'); fs.writeFileSync('public/occ/opencascade.wasm.js', content); }"
